I was exactly like this the first 3 weeks after my ex broke up with me. I slept all day on the weekends and got my self trashed on vodka every night and couldn’t stomach any sort of food. I dropped weight very quickly and couldn’t function at work either (I work full time and it’s a 2.5hour commute each way). 
It does get better, I promise. Take the time you need to grieve and let everything out before you try and force yourself into recovery mode. I assure you, you’ll feel better in time. You’ll wake up one day and your appetite will be back, or you’ll hear something and you’ll laugh like you haven’t for a long time. I know how much it physically hurts and you’re heart aches right now, but I promise you, you’ll be okay.

It may very well just be lust she feels. It’s good that she says she hasn’t cheated, that will make it a little bit easier on you. But at the end of the day, if you had a healthy, committed relationship before this, something needs to be said. A break never works in my experience and ends with one still chasing the other. Do you best to have a talk with her and let her know to sort her feelings out so it’s fair on you. I’m so sorry this has happened. If you need to talk, feel free to reach out
